title: Publish the prepared immutable commit rather than a mutable release-branch name
rationale: A publishing invocation A computes tree T1 and commit C1, moves release/v5.0-clean to C1, and asks the biometric gate to attest TREE_DIGEST=T1. While A is waiting, another invocation B (including --dry-run) can derive a different clean tree T2 from a later/different HEAD and move the same release branch to C2. After A receives its valid attestation for T1, its push resolves the mutable branch name instead of using its saved CLEAN_COMMIT. It can therefore publish C2/T2 under an authorization request for T1. The script contains no shared lock or equality check between the source ref and CLEAN_COMMIT before push. This is an independent effect-to-attestation binding defect, not a complaint that dry-run creates local objects. It requires overlapping invocations, different source trees, successful earlier checks, an available remote and valid approval for A; none of these effects or deployment conditions were executed or asserted as observed.

source_checks.observation: Each invocation derives and saves CLEAN_TREE from the HEAD it reads.
TREE_DIGEST is bound to that invocation's tree and CLEAN_COMMIT is saved, but a shared release branch is overwritten.
Biometric authorization receives TREE_DIGEST, creating a window before publication.
A dry-run invocation still updates the shared branch before exiting.
After the gate, push uses release/v5.0-clean:main instead of the saved CLEAN_COMMIT, with no intervening ref-equality verification.
The canonical contract requires protected effects to be bound to their actual hash.

guards: Both invocations must pass their earlier content and archive checks; dry-run does not directly push.
The biometric failure path stops A, but successful approval remains tied to T1 rather than the later ref value.
An immutable per-invocation commit is already available as CLEAN_COMMIT but is not used as the push source.
No remote state, concurrent run or native/biometric/Git effect was exercised.
suggested_remediation: Use the saved CLEAN_COMMIT as the push source and retain the corresponding TREE_DIGEST through approval; independently decide whether the shared local convenience branch should be replaced, uniquely named or locked.
